scope: Architecture and PM audit remediation; local verification only

tasks.title: Reject active uploads and contain legacy assets
tasks.acceptance: SVG and MIME spoofing rejected; legacy active content cannot execute on application origin

tasks.title: Preserve trusted client identity through BFF and gateway
tasks.acceptance: Independent clients have independent quotas; forged identity rejected

tasks.title: Asymmetric JWT signing and public-key verification
tasks.acceptance: Production resource services cannot mint tokens; rotation and invalid claims tested

tasks.title: Coordinate refresh across BFF instances
tasks.acceptance: Concurrent rotations across processes preserve the same browser session without replaying stale credentials

tasks.title: Remove enrollment callback cycle and network waits inside database transactions
tasks.acceptance: Assignment validates identity and ownership without callback dependency or held transaction

tasks.title: Bound course, assignment and meeting read amplification
tasks.acceptance: Authorization uses minimal projections; assignment queries do not grow per lesson

tasks.title: Complete assignment authoring and account recovery UI
tasks.acceptance: Staff create mandatory work and users recover passwords through BFF/UI

tasks.title: Durable role workflow startup and recovery
tasks.acceptance: Committed requests survive lost delivery and retry without duplicate grants

tasks.title: Explicit production configuration, bootstrap and recovery operations
tasks.acceptance: Fail-closed production startup; isolated backup/restore and initial administrator procedures verified
tasks.remaining: Target-environment alerting, backup schedule/RPO/RTO and existing-data cutover rehearsal require operator deployment.

tasks.title: Bound file delivery and define publication policy
tasks.acceptance: Safe attachment headers, explicit privacy policy, bounded delivery and storage limits

tasks.title: Meeting placement and capacity verification
tasks.acceptance: Room placement is explicit; mesh/device/network limits are measured or explicitly unresolved
tasks.remaining: External TURN and eight physical devices cannot be validated by this local run; singleton transport is enforced and tested.

tasks.title: CI regression gates, current risk register and repeat architecture/PM audit
tasks.acceptance: Fresh backend/browser/security checks; each original finding closed with evidence or retained explicitly

follow_up_findings.title: Assign instructors to courses without granting global editor authority
follow_up_findings.acceptance: Admin assigns an active instructor; own course work succeeds; foreign/revoked assignment is denied server-side

follow_up_findings.title: Refresh token family replay revocation
follow_up_findings.acceptance: Stolen-token replay revokes the compromised family while legitimate shared BFF retries stay valid

follow_up_findings.title: Complete security supply-chain gates and remote CI evidence
follow_up_findings.acceptance: Release JAR/image SCA, SBOM, secret and relevant static/config scans block failures on the actual runner

follow_up_findings.title: External TURN/device capacity, deployment operations and existing-data rehearsal
follow_up_findings.acceptance: Real network/device tests, staffed alerting, backup schedule/recovery targets and rehearsal on a copy of existing data

release_verdict: Supervised admin/editor-led pilot; independent public production is not approved
